name: wsi_bench_pathkgen
description: Benchmark for whole-slide image (WSI) pathology tasks focused on generating pathology-related outputs (e.g., reports, diagnostic labels, or educational knowledge) from high-resolution WSI inputs. Designed to evaluate models' ability to interpret histopathology images and produce clinical or knowledge-grounded text or labels.
evaluation_method: BLEU/ROUGE/CIDEr for generated text; accuracy/F1 for classification labels
reputation: Relatively new and specialized dataset with limited adoption outside pathology/WSI research groups.
